newsitem.title: USA: Hawaiian Airlines in AIRMAX deal with Sabre.
newsitem.headline: Hawaiian Airlines in AIRMAX deal with Sabre.

text.p: Hawaiian Airlines Inc said it signed an agreement with a Sabre Group Holdings Inc unit to provide the airline with a yield management system called AIRMAX.
The company did not announce terms of the agreement. Officials at Hawaiian Airlines were not immediately available to comment.
The AIRMAX system optimizes the allocation of seat inventory and pricing on a flight-by-flight, minute-to-minute basis, the company said.
The Sabre unit is Sabre Decision Technologies.
